So likely the charge is "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". Also possibly "过失致人死亡罪" (negligent homicide). Chinese law distinguishes: If the act is a dangerous method (e.g., building without safety), it's dangerous method crime. If just negligence, it's "过失致人死亡". Many cases of construction collapse are prosecuted under dangerous method. So we list that. Could there be multiple? Possibly also "非法占用土地罪"? No. So answer: [罪名]以危险方法危害公共安全罪<eoa>
